allow_instructions: Allow reads, edits, tests, lint, and builds in this repository.
Allow git status, diff, log, add, and commit on feature branches.
Allow opening a pull request for a feature branch. Do not merge to main unless the notebook plan's current step says to.
Allow npm install, npm ci, npm test, npm run lint, npm run build, and Playwright.
block_instructions: Ask for approval before any command that adds, removes, or edits the domains ariella.website, www.ariella.website, or photos.ariella.website.
Ask for approval before vercel --prod, production deploys, Porkbun or DNS changes, and creating or changing a Render service.
Ask for approval before git push --force, git reset --hard, or deleting a Vercel project.
